interpretation.authority_route_available: At least one direct authoritative online route/identifier is recorded for every work in text_access_index_100_v0.3.json.
interpretation.detailed_crosswalk_records: Records with the stronger v0.2 Work/Version/parallel foundation. These can support deeper compare UI earlier.
interpretation.authority_route_only_or_partial: Not 'unverified'; these have an authority route but still need richer version-level chronology, parallels, witness links and bibliography before scholar-grade compare.

rule: Direct authority route ≠ proof that different recensions are identical. Deep crosswalk remains Work → Version → Witness → Parallel → Bibliography.
